name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I have prepared leather goods for Jahan to sell at the Crossroads.  Will you bring them to him?

If you have already been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our Thunder Bluff wind riders back to him.

Take the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in Thunder Bluff, and speak with him to arrange transport to the Crossroads.
narrative.objectives: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: You need to take this to the Crossroads, eh? That's not a problem. If you've already been there and spoken to Devrak, then you can take one of my wind riders back to him.
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetings, Champion. What can I do for you?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 10, 1,890 XP in all.

quests.name: A Bundle of Hides
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Return to Jahan
quests.objectiveText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
